title: Agora servant read-only data tools that return cited facts
problem_register_class: RC4 — Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader (SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 T2)
design_choices: Tool rounds run in agora-interaction-worker (AD-AG-05), in BFF code (services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/), so a tool call is resolved by the BFF and never by the model.

Each round is one OpenClaw /structured call with SERVANT_TURN_SCHEMA (adapter-enforced keywords only; pinned by services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/tests/test_servant_tool_turn_schema_contract.py). The conversation history (last 20 messages, T1) travels inside the turn packet.

The model shows a value only by writing a fact reference {{fN}}; the BFF renders value and unit from the tool result. Any other number in the model text that is not a stock code, a fact date or a number the trader wrote is replaced by 〔未引用數字〕 and recorded in metadata.tool_turn.number_guard.
broker_branch_flow reads the keyed tw_broker_top dataset through a new bounded source-ingest owner route instead of paging the tenant-wide source-records list.
If the provider fails after tools returned facts, the answer is a deterministic facts-only list (answer_mode=facts_only) so 分析分點 still returns cited rows.

implementation: services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/data_tools.py::ServantDataTools (market_bars, candidate_pool, candidate_ranking, broker_branch_flow, disclosures, news, my_decisions, my_journal, my_shadow, institutional_facts, propose_research)
fact shape: {id, tool, label, value, unit, source_id, connector_id | owner, as_of, freshness (AD-AG-07: fresh|stale|empty_fresh|unavailable|degraded|not_configured), query_hash, cited}

freshness SLAs: broker 4 days (weekend/holiday slack), MOPS 1 day, collector news 6 hours, market bars 4 days; an unconfigured source is not_configured and an owner error is unavailable, never an empty market
services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/tool_turn.py::run_tool_turn (MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS=4, MAX_CALLS_PER_ROUND=4; at most 5 provider calls per turn; must_answer_now after round 4)
services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/tool_turn.py::render_answer (fact references rendered by the BFF; model numbers removed)

services/source_ingestion/routers/ingest_operations.py::get_broker_branch_flow — GET /api/source-ingest/broker-branch-flow?symbols=&date_from=&date_to=&side=buy|sell|both&top= over keyed/tw_broker_top; reads only the requested session partitions; ≤20 symbols, ≤10 sessions, top ≤20 per side, ≤2000 rows; latest stored session by default; strict runtime auth (source_ingest_reader)
services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/data_tools.py::SourceIngestToolClient — short-lived service JWT (role source_ingest_reader, turn tenant, iss/aud when configured)
the servant tool reads ≤5 symbols, top 3 per side
tests: services/source_ingestion/tests/test_broker_branch_flow_route.py (5 tests; the evidence repository is a tripwire, so the tenant-wide source-records list is never read)

implementation: unknown tool or unconfigured/unavailable owner -> missing entry; model missing_data merged; answer ends with 「缺少的資料：…。我不會用模型記憶當作資料回答。」; memory numbers are removed by the number guard

services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/router.py::ServantCommandContext — optional `context` {page, strategy_id, widget_id, selected_symbols ≤20, quick_task} on POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{session_id}/messages, stored on the trader message

services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/data_tools.py::seeded_tool_calls — quick_task 「分析分點」/analyze_broker_branches runs broker_branch_flow on the selected symbols as the first tool round, without asking the model

no tool, schema field or provider call in the turn reaches a persona or a meeting; the free-form invoke_assistant_provider path is no longer used by the servant turn; metadata.tool_turn.persona_calls=0

ac7_hosted_proof.blocking_condition: On hosted Dev the agora-interaction-worker compose service has no source-ingest URL and no runtime JWT secret, so every source-ingest tool would answer not_configured. docker-compose.yml is outside this task's artifact contract. The worker needs, in the agora-interaction-worker environment: PANTHEON_SOURCE_INGEST_API_URL=${PANTHEON_SOURCE_INGEST_API_URL:-http://source-ingest:8097}, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET=${PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET:-${PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_SECRET:-${PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET:-}}}, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_ISSUER and PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_AUDIENCE with the same fallbacks as the source-ingest service (docker-compose.yml:342-344).
procedure_after_deploy: POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/messages with content 分析分點 and context {quick_task: analyze_broker_branches, selected_symbols: [<held symbol, e.g. 2330>]}

GET /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/stream: record the servant.message.completed citations (connector tw-finmind-broker-daily-report, as_of = latest stored session, source_id per row) and answer_mode
Record MOPS (tw-mops-official-disclosures) and news (collector-news-rss) freshness from the disclosures and news tool results (newest record time and freshness state)

contracts.backend_routes_manifest: unchanged: no new BFF path (scripts/bff_route_manifest_backend.py --check: routes match snapshot)
contracts.openclaw_structured_schema: services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/tool_turn.py::SERVANT_TURN_SCHEMA; adapter source unchanged, contract test added

runtime_budget.writer: the existing servant answer message (Agora owner append_session_message) now carries citations and a tool_turn summary
runtime_budget.size: ≤30 citations per answer at ~400 B each, ≤ ~12 KB worst case (5 symbols × top 3 buy + top 3 sell = 30 facts measured at < 14 KB in test_analyze_five_selected_symbols_fits_the_citation_budget); a single-symbol 分析分點 is 6 facts ≈ 2.5 KB; a text-only answer adds ~0.5 KB of tool_turn metadata
runtime_budget.growth_and_cap: bounded by the T1 session cap (500 messages, so ≤250 answers per session) and 180-day session retention; no new growth path
runtime_budget.cleanup: existing T1 purge of servant sessions untouched for 180 days
runtime_budget.llm_calls: ≤5 structured calls per servant turn (≤4 tool rounds + answer); 1 when no tool is needed
runtime_budget.owner_reads_per_turn: ≤16 tool calls (4 rounds × 4); each source-records scan ≤3 pages of 200; the broker route reads ≤10 session partitions
runtime_budget.cadence: on demand, one turn per trader message

verification.result: 276 passed; route manifest matches snapshot; route diff baseline matches

residual_findings.summary: agora-interaction-worker compose env lacks the source-ingest URL and runtime JWT secret/issuer/audience the servant tools need on hosted (see ac7 blocking_condition). docker-compose.yml is outside this task's artifacts.
residual_findings.disposition: needs artifact-contract addition or a follow-up deploy-config task before the hosted proof

residual_findings.summary: my_journal and institutional_facts are wired but will answer not_configured/unavailable in the worker until it has a decision-journal reader (the persona read client has no list_decision_journal_entries) and evaluation/memory owner URLs; they report the missing data instead of answering.
residual_findings.disposition: recorded; not required by the hosted proof

residual_findings.summary: AgoraWriteService.list_decision_locks reads the whole decision-lock table and filters in process; my_decisions/my_shadow inherit that. Bounded today by the hosted lock count (0 on 2026-11-26).
